observationMethod: Actual three PNG previews opened individually at original resolution. The initial canvas PNG was also opened once before the one targeted repair. These are author observations, not an independent PASS.
sourceFindings: O/A/B/C/D/E/K, Q/P and the unlabelled E foot are present; A/Q and K/P projections remain vertical.
Proportional, elastic and ultimate guides terminate at A/B/E respectively; B is below the C-D plateau.

The solid schematic curve rises through OA/AB/BC, has a C-D plateau, rises to E, then drops to K above zero stress. No calibrated ticks, numerical coordinates, true-stress curve or unloading line was added.

Horizontal spacing is redistributed for readable labels and is explicitly schematic rather than calibrated source strain data. This changes drawing geometry, not the order or the guide/point relationships.
Current frozen prose uses initial-area engineering stress and attributes the terminal decrease to necking/load-capacity behavior, not intrinsic stress softening alone.
All visible words are ordinary English; mathematical sigma/epsilon and point letters are allowed. No Cyrillic source subscripts remain.
All previews are nonblank and unclipped. Native measured minimum text is 32px at640, 16.55px at331, 17.1px at342.
